chunks: 4577 - Al-Hasan ibn Mahbub narrated from Jamil ibn Darraj, from Durays ibn Abd al-Malik, from Abu Abdillah عليه السلام:
Regarding a man who makes his bondwoman lawful for his brother, and she goes out in his needs, he said: "She is lawful for him."

I said: "What if she gives birth to a child? What is to be done with him?" He said: "He belongs to the master of the bondwoman, unless he had stipulated to him at the time he made her lawful for him that if she came with a child from me, then he is free. So if he did that, then he is free."
I said: "Then can he own his child?" He said: "If he has wealth, he may buy him at the proper value."

key_terms.اشْتَرَطَ: he stipulated; he set a binding condition beforehand
key_terms.بِالْقِيمَةِ: at the proper value; according to assessed price
key_terms.بِوَلَدٍ: with a child; referring to childbirth from that union
key_terms.جَارِيَتَهُ: his bondwoman; the female slave under his ownership
key_terms.حَلَالٌ: lawful and permitted in the legal sense
key_terms.لِمَوْلَى الْجَارِيَةِ: belonging to the master of the bondwoman

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling on a child born from a bondwoman made lawful to another man?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling about a man permitting another to have relations with his bondwoman and the status of any child born from that arrangement. The Imam عليه السلام explains that the child belongs to the bondwoman’s owner unless a prior condition of freedom was stipulated, and if the biological father has wealth, he may purchase the child at assessed value.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.4577 - Al-Hasan ibn Mahbub narrated from Jamil ibn Darraj, from Durays ibn Abdul-Malik, from Abu Abdillah (as) regarding a man who permits his brother to have relations with his bondwoman, and she goes out to fulfill his needs.
Imam (as) said: "She is lawful for him."

I asked: "What if she gives birth to a child? What should be done with the child?"
Imam (as) said: "The child belongs to the owner of the bondwoman unless he stipulated at the time he permitted her that if she gives birth to a child from him, then the child is free. If he made such a condition, then the child is free."

I asked: "Can he own his child?"
Imam (as) said: "If he has wealth, he can purchase the child at its value."
